lessons.title: Melody Architecture — How T-Pain Builds Hooks

body.text: Hooks Goals: Teach the math behind catchiness. Teach his formula: 1. Simple, repeating melodic line 2. Bounce-first rhythm 3. Clean rhyme scheme 4. Harmony stacks (3–6 layers) 5.
